# LSE Blogs

> > LSE Blogs is a premier platform for expert academic commentary on global politics, policy, economics, and social issues from the London School of Economics.

LSE Blogs hosts over 20 specialized research blogs covering regional geopolitics, policy analysis, business and economics, social inequalities, media studies, and human rights. The platform features contributions from LSE faculty, researchers, and students providing evidence-based perspectives on contemporary political and social challenges.

## Key Topics

- UK Politics
- European Politics
- US Politics
- Geopolitics
- Policy Analysis
- Academic Research
- International Affairs
- Social Inequalities
- Media and Communications
- Human Rights
- Gender Equality
- China Analysis
- Africa
- South Asia
- Middle East

## Core Platforms

- [LSE Blogs](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk): LSE's main blogging platform for expert commentary on political, social and economic issues
- [Students@LSE](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/studentsatlse): Students@LSE covering admissions, student life, guides and application information

## Politics and Policy Analysis

- [British Politics and Policy at LSE](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/politicsandpolicy): Top academic blog on British politics, public policy and foreign affairs hosted at LSE
- [LSE United States Politics and Policy](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/usappblog): LSE commentary and analysis on US politics, elections and foreign policy
- [LSE European Politics](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/europpblog): LSE European Politics blog covering EU politics, elections, economics and policy analysis
- [Greece@LSE](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/greeceatlse): Greece@LSE blog covering Greek politics, economics and South East European analysis

## Regional and Global Affairs

- [Africa at LSE](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/africaatlse): Expert analysis on African political, social and economic affairs and development
- [South Asia @ LSE](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/southasia): South Asia analysis from LSE South Asia Centre covering regional politics and economics
- [LSE Middle East Centre Blog](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/mec): LSE Middle East Centre blog on MENA region research, conflict and policy analysis
- [China Dialogues](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/cff): China Dialogues platform for expert discussion on China analysis and geopolitics

## Business, Economics and Research Impact

- [LSE Business Review](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/businessreview): LSE Business Review covering economics, finance, management, sustainability and technology research
- [LSE Impact](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/impactofsocialsciences): Platform for understanding and increasing the impact of academic research and public engagement

## Social Issues and Human Rights

- [LSE Inequalities](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/inequalities): Expert analysis on social, economic and political inequalities grounded in research
- [LSE Human Rights](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/humanrights): Student-led blog on human rights, conflict studies, international law and social justice
- [LSE Women, Peace and Security](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/wps): LSE blog on women, peace and security covering gender equality and conflict issues
- [Parenting for a Digital Future](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/parenting4digitalfuture): Research blog on parenting, child online safety and digital futures from LSE

## Media, Culture and Society

- [LSE Review of Books](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/lsereviewofbooks): World's largest open access social science book reviews website from LSE
- [Media@LSE](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/medialse): Media@LSE promoting critical research on media, communications and contemporary society
- [Religion and Global Society](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/religionglobalsociety): Research-led interdisciplinary blog on religion and its relevance in world affairs
- [Activism, Influence and Change](https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/activism-influence-change): LSE blog on activism, grassroots organizing and social change movements
